description: The same handover with blanking cut to 30 us. Locked within ~10 ms of the modulation switch and held for the rest of the capture with zero faults.
notes: Sector rate 829-941 rad/s el, rotor-driven (crossing-timed commutation is a rotor measurement, unlike a forced drive).
Settled current 0.03-0.14 A: the duty loop finds torque balance - closed-loop six-step is as economical as closed-loop FOC. The earlier 0.5 A six-step figures were forced-mode artifacts.
title: First lock: 30 us blanking, held 8 s
